name: Henry Williams
bio: Henry Williams, a cowboy working for Gregor Lang, won a steer-roping prize at the June 1886 round-up, and in July a Henry Williams of the Neimmella cattle company set a roping record. In December 1886 a warrant was issued for his arrest as an accessory in the case against George Myers.
